incident-bot: PAGER: [ALERT] regional-health-eu: sustained p95 latency > 1.8s and 5xx > 2% (window=3m) — paging @Sam (eng-oncall). alert_id=rbx-4932.
Sam (eng-oncall): Ack. Starting triage. Opening thread.
Aisha (eng-sre): I'll grab graphs. Any recent deploys to proxies/cache in eu?
Diego (eng-platform): No deploys in last 6h. Autoscaler events show HPA scaled +1 at 14:08 but pods still saturated on CPU. Looks like tail-latency from background batch jobs coinciding with a surge of short-lived clients from a crawler.
Lena (prod-ops): CS: multiple EU customers reporting timed-out responses ~14:06-14:15 UTC. Collecting request IDs.
Sam (eng-oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) add temporary traffic split to us-west (20%), 2) bump regional-proxy-eu replicas from 4 -> 10, 3) add a short-lived suppression for the noisy alert so we don't re-page while scaling. Thoughts?
Aisha (eng-sre): Agreed. Also suggest increasing alert evaluation window from 3m -> 7m and require both p95 AND 5xx to be sustained. We get a lot of 2-3m blips. Proposed promrule change snippet: ```- alert: RegionalProxyHighError
  expr: (sum(rate(proxy_request_latencies_bucket{region=\"eu\"}[5m])) by (le) > 1.8) and (sum(rate(proxy_5xx_total{region=\"eu\"}[5m])) by (instance) > 0.02)
  for: 7m
```
Diego (eng-platform): I'll apply scaling now. Running: ```kubectl -n infra scale deployment/regional-proxy-eu --replicas=10```
Sam (eng-oncall): Applying alert suppression: moving alert to #incidents-warn for duration 20m: `alerts.mute(rbx-4932, 20m)` (done).
incident-bot: deploy-bot: no deploys found. Autoscaler events: HPA limit reached for regional-proxy-eu (desired=12, max=10).
Aisha (eng-sre): That's the issue — HPA max too low for sudden bot floods. Diego, can you temporarily increase HPA max to 20? We should also add headroom to HPA policy.
Diego (eng-platform): Increasing HPA max to 20 now. ```kubectl -n infra patch hpa regional-proxy-eu -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":20}}'```
Lena (prod-ops): After scale start, latency p95 falling from 2.3s -> 0.9s over 6 minutes. 5xx dropping below 0.6%. Good trend.
Sam (eng-oncall): Good. Mitigation looks effective. CS: please send customers an interim note — we scaled and added failover while we investigate root cause.
CS Team: Copy, drafting update. ETA 10m.
Aisha (eng-sre): Post-mitigation monitoring items: - create multi-region failover dashboard (eu/us-west/us-east) showing traffic weight, p95, 5xx, failover triggers - add synthetic probe hitting proxy->redis path in eu every 30s - tune alerts per Diego's suggestion (7m window + combined condition) - update runbook to document HPA headroom and temporary failover knobs.
Sam (eng-oncall): Filing follow-ups: MON-2319 (alerting tuning), DASH-2320 (multi-region dashboard), RCA-2321 (investigate crawler/redis interactions). Assigning to eng-sre + eng-platform.
incident-bot: Created follow-ups: MON-2319, DASH-2320, RCA-2321. Incident state -> mitigated:monitoring.
Diego (eng-platform): Quick note on alert noise: let's move non-actionable pagers to WARN for 72h while we roll out new rules. Also adding a suppression for short blips (<5m) globally for regional-health alerts.
Aisha (eng-sre): I'll own dashboard + alert changes. Plan: land prom rule change, deploy to staging, run 48h of synthetic traffic, then promote. Will also add grafana panel: traffic-weight + failover-decision timeline.
Sam (eng-oncall): Handoff: I'm handing to Aisha for overnight watch. Current state: proxies scaled, traffic partially shifted to us-west, metrics stable. If 5xx > 1% for 10m escalate to oncall.
Aisha (eng-sre): Ack. I'll monitor and update. Good job all. :thumbsup:
CS Team: We'll include impacted customers in post-mortem and provide timeline.
Sam (eng-oncall): Final action: update runbook link with HPA knob and alert tuning checklist -> https://runbooks.internal/redwood/regional-failover. Add steps to mute noisy alerts safely.
incident-bot: Incident closed -> monitoring. Follow-ups scheduled.
